# --- STEP 1: Embed UI files as binary data -----------------------------------
#
# This creates a static library target "PluginScope_UIResources" containing
# all HTML, JS, CSS files baked into the binary as C++ byte arrays.
#
juce_add_binary_data(PluginScope_UIResources
    HEADER_NAME "BinaryData.h"
    NAMESPACE   "BinaryData"
    SOURCES
        # Production HTML (copy of v1-ui.html, renamed)
        Source/ui/public/index.html

        # JUCE WebView frontend library (required for window.__JUCE__ bridge)
        # Source file: <JUCE>/modules/juce_gui_extra/native/javascript/index.js
        # Destination: Source/ui/public/js/juce/index.js
        Source/ui/public/js/juce/index.js

        # Add additional assets here if needed (CSS, images, fonts):
        # Source/ui/public/css/fonts.css
        # Source/ui/public/fonts/Inter-Regular.woff2
)

# --- STEP 2: Link UIResources + WebView modules to plugin target -------------
#
# Append to the existing target_link_libraries() call in CMakeLists.txt.
# Do NOT create a second target_link_libraries() — append to the existing one.
#
# Example (adapt to actual CMakeLists structure):

target_link_libraries(PluginScope
    PRIVATE
        PluginScope_UIResources   # Embedded HTML/JS/CSS files
        juce::juce_gui_extra      # Required for juce::WebBrowserComponent
        # ... other existing libraries ...
    PUBLIC
        juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
)

# --- STEP 3: Compile definitions for WebView ---------------------------------
#
# Append to the existing target_compile_definitions() call.
# JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=1 enables WebBrowserComponent.
# JUCE_USE_CURL=0 avoids libcurl dependency (not needed for WebView).
#
target_compile_definitions(PluginScope
    PUBLIC
        JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=1
        JUCE_USE_CURL=0
        # Windows-specific: use WebView2 (Chromium-based)
        # Requires NuGet package Microsoft.Web.WebView2 on Windows builds
        # JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2=1
)

# --- NOTES -------------------------------------------------------------------

# macOS:
#   WebView uses WKWebView (system-provided, no extra dependencies).
#   Requires macOS 10.13+ for WKWebView with custom schemes.
#   Add to entitlements if needed: com.apple.security.network.client

# Linux:
#   Requires libwebkit2gtk-4.0-dev (GTK backend).
